statement: models.preferences.set normalizes enabled-model references by stripping thinking-level suffixes, rejects input that disables every available model, and persists via SettingsManager.setEnabledModels.

API-key set/delete and logout are verified after the mutation by listing credentials back (credentialStateMatches); a committed credential is never reported as a hard failure, only as a MODEL_SYNC_FAILED warning if the local refresh fails.

Session history is paged from the leaf by turns and byte budget using cursors anchored to a historyRevision and beforeEntryId; oversized content blocks are deferred with previews and loaded later via sessions.entryContent.

The SessionIndex scans the sessions root for jsonl files and fingerprints each by size/mtime/ctime/ino so unchanged files are reused without re-parsing, and derives project root and worktree branch views.
The app protocol handles the UI bundle over app:// with no TCP server; protocol.handle serves static files with CSP headers and supports ephemeral HTML preview entries.
The renderer entry is the Vite dev URL only while VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL is set; otherwise it is served from the built renderer via app://bundle/index.html.
connectAccount probes the credential, persists the secret via Main's vault, upserts the account enabled, and restarts its runtime; any failure removes the provisional account and secret.
Channel accounts and bindings persist in channels.json through a store that normalizes every account/binding on read and writes atomically with mode 0600.
Download requires phase available, install requires phase downloaded, and install is rejected while active Agent sessions are running (UPDATE_BUSY / installBlockedByActiveSessions).

The update manager state machine runs disabled/idle/checking/up-to-date/available/downloading/downloaded/installing/error with automatic checks after a 60s initial delay then a 6-hour interval with ±8% jitter.

Stop marks stopping and awaits the backend within an 8.5s timeout (force-dispose on timeout marks lost); a user stop sets a barrier the Agent cannot restart across, and restart allocates a fresh runId/generation so stale runs are rejected.
Readiness supports waitFor none/output-contains/loopback-url, with readiness states not-requested/pending/ready/timed-out and loopback endpoints extracted only from localhost/127.0.0.1.
The project requires Node.js >=22.19 <23 and exposes scripts for dev, build, test, verify, pack, dist, smoke, and platform-specific checks.

statement: npm run build bundles main/preload/host with tsup and the renderer with Vite into out/ (building the Windows helper on win32 x64); the renderer loads Vite only while VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL is set, else app://bundle/index.html.
PublicToolchainState is path-free: it carries redacted pathLabels, per-capability preference/provider/version/health, managed component states, caches, and install operations.
The Agent's bash tool runs with the resolved shell descriptor and shellEnv (plus a beforeExec hook), and git operations route through the resolved vcs.git descriptor via the shared worktree runner.
Skills search queries the skills.sh API first and falls back to the Pi skills CLI via runNpx; installation runs the skills add CLI.
Electron Main supervises the Host with a ping/pong heartbeat (15s interval, 10s timeout) and a bounded restart budget of 2 restarts within a 30s crash window before status flips to crashed.
The RPC server keeps per-port subscriptions and leases; requestContext.setLease/releaseLease tie resource finalizers to the port's lifetime, and attachPort drops the port when the remote side closes.

The renderer-facing RPC surface is fully typed by the Api interface (method name to params/result types) and the Streams interface (server-push topics) in src/contract/api.ts; ApiMethod and StreamTopic derive from their keys.

HTML previews are served under app://preview with a much narrower CSP (default-src none, object-src none, form-action none), a 30-minute TTL, a 64-entry cap, a 1 MiB content limit, and assets confined to the preview directory capped at 20 MiB.

check-desktop-security.mjs statically asserts roughly one hundred security invariants (sandbox flags, CSP, no remote debugging, credential vaults, channel transport, browser preflight order, redaction) and fails npm run verify on any regression.

statement: The test-platforms CI job runs the unit/quality matrix on Linux x64, macOS arm64, macOS x64, and Windows x64 with pinned Rust toolchains, and Windows additionally runs cargo fmt/clippy/test, cargo audit, cargo deny, helper reproducibility, managed-process workflows, and the 60s flood.

test-platforms:
    name: Tests (${{ matrix.name }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: Linux x64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04
            timeout_minutes: 25
          - name: macOS arm64
            runner: macos-15
            timeout_minutes: 25
          - name: macOS x64
            runner: macos-15-intel
            timeout_minutes: 25
          - name: Windows x64
            runner: windows-2025
            timeout_minutes: 45
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: ${{ matrix.timeout_minutes }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Install pinned Rust toolchain (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: rustup toolchain install 1.96.1-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --profile minimal --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc

      - name: Install pinned Windows cross toolchain (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install 1.96.1 --profile minimal --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
          cargo install cargo-xwin --locked --version 0.23.1
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install --no-install-recommends clang-18 lld-18 llvm-18

      - name: Compile-check Windows helper with cargo-xwin (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: npm run build:windows-helper

      - name: Install pinned Rust supply-chain gates (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: |
          cargo install cargo-audit --locked --version 0.22.2
          cargo install cargo-deny --locked --version 0.20.2

      - name: Install Electron binary (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: npx install-electron --no

      - name: Validate Windows managed process helper
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
          $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $true
          python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --no-input Flask==3.1.0 fastapi==0.128.0 uvicorn==0.40.0
          cargo fmt --manifest-path native/windows-managed-process-helper/Cargo.toml --all -- --check
          cargo clippy --manifest-path native/windows-managed-process-helper/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc -- -D warnings
          cargo test --manifest-path native/windows-managed-process-helper/Cargo.toml --locked --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
          cargo audit --file native/windows-managed-process-helper/Cargo.lock --deny warnings
          cargo deny --manifest-path native/windows-managed-process-helper/Cargo.toml --config native/windows-managed-process-helper/deny.toml --locked check
          npm run check:windows-helper-reproducibility
          $env:PI_WINDOWS_HELPER_HANDLE_LOOPS = "100"
          npm run test:windows-managed-helper
          npm run test:managed-process-workflows
          $env:PI_MANAGED_FLOOD_DURATION_MS = "60000"
          $env:PI_MANAGED_FLOOD_PROCESSES = "8"
          $env:PI_MANAGED_FLOOD_STREAMS = "both"
          npm run test:managed-process-flood

      - name: Run unit and handler tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Run cross-platform quality checks (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: |
          npm run format:check
          npm run lint
          npm run typecheck
          npm run check:dependencies
          npm run check:contract
          npm run check:pi-compat
          npm run check:toolchain-contract
          npm run check:toolchain-catalog
          npm run check:browser-i18n

statement: npm test runs node --test over src/**/*.test.mjs with a per-test timeout from PI_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS (default 120s), rejects legacy test-bundle usage, and cleans .artifacts/test-modules before and after.
verify-windows-helper-reproducibility builds the release helper twice with a targeted cargo clean between builds and fails unless the sha256 hashes match.

In owner mode the helper creates the named Job, prepares a suspended target, assigns it to the Job before resume, streams stdout/stderr, forwards stdin, stops the process tree in graceful phases (CTRL_C, CTRL_BREAK, then Job terminate), and terminates the Job if the owner identity is lost.
npm run pack and npm run dist run the full verify gate before electron-builder.

npm run verify is the single quality gate (format, lint, typechecks, dependency contract, unit tests, managed-process suites, contract/security checks, build, smoke, browser integration) that aborts on the first failure.

handleAppProtocol serves the built renderer over the privileged app:// scheme with a strict CSP and path containment, and serves user HTML previews under app://preview with a narrower CSP, 30-minute TTL, and bounded assets.
Automatic update checks start after 60s and repeat every 6 hours with 8% jitter, with a 15-minute download watchdog.

handleInbound runs inside a per-route lane and performs policy evaluation, attachment download/staging, binding resolution, command or bridge turn execution, session-changed emission, reply delivery, generated-file delivery, and activity/status updates.

A binding key is channel:accountId:peerKind:peerId:threadId with the binding id derived from its SHA-256, and bindings default to a workspace under userData/channel-workspaces/<channel>/<account>/<hash> unless the account sets defaultCwd.

Renderer connections use MessageChannelMain with one port forwarded to the Host via attach-port and pre-ready ports queued until spawn; Main also issues one-shot RPCs over fresh channels with a 10-second default timeout and answers Host-initiated host-rpc requests through its request handler.

Main owns window lifecycle, menus, tray/badge, deep links, updates, protocol, and Host supervision with no business logic, while the Agent Host utilityProcess runs pi-coding-agent in-process and serves Api/Streams over MessagePort.

statement: The toolchain catalog is loaded from <resources>/toolchains/runtime-catalog.json in packaged builds or build/toolchains/runtime-catalog.json in development, is rejected above 2 MiB, is parsed through parseRuntimeCatalog, and findCatalogComponent/findCatalogVariant fail closed when a component or platform variant is missing.

Toolchain snapshots derived from the catalog are pushed to the Host as toolchain:init/toolchain:changed and must be acknowledged by revision; a replacement Host must acknowledge both policy snapshots itself, and packaged startup validation requires the ack revision to reach the snapshot revision.

The managed-process crash reaper persists records in <userData>/managed-process-reaper/journal-v2.json (version 2, capped at 64 KiB and 16 records, strict per-platform validation with POSIX pid===pgid and legacy v1 migration) so leftover process groups can be reaped after crashes, failing closed when a live pid's start fingerprint does not match.

HTML previews are in-memory only, expiring after 30 minutes and capped at 64 entries, and the Agent Host keeps session-id-to-path mappings and per-session tool names in memory for the Host's lifetime.
Stops are graceful-then-force with an 8.5-second total timeout, and aborting the starting session's turn stops that session's managed processes.

Managed background processes are a lifecycle-containment feature, not a sandbox: child processes have the same local file, network, and environment permissions as Agent Bash, the feature is off by default, and supported platforms are macOS, Linux, and Windows 11 x64 (Windows ARM64, Windows Server, and 32-bit Windows are unsupported).

## 应用截图 ![Pi Agent Desktop 主工作区：会话、Agent 回复与代码预览](./images/app-workspace.jpg)

技能浏览、启用与内容编辑

## 核心能力 ### 一个完整的 Agent 工作台 - 创建、切换、重命名和删除会话，并持续展示流式回复 - 新会话可根据首条有效消息在后台自动生成简短标题；可在设置中关闭，手动名称始终优先 - 搜索会话、按日期分组浏览，并在列表和主对话顶部使用稳定的会话标题 - 查看工具调用、执行过程和上下文压缩状态 - 支持排队消息、Steer / Follow-up 等交互方式 - 快速切换模型、推理等级、工具预设和提示音 - 支持图片附件、斜杠命令与 `@` 文件引用 - 对话与输入框使用一致的阅读宽度，右侧文件面板可通过鼠标或键盘调整并记住宽度 ### 用户与 Agent 共享的内置浏览器 - 在主界面右侧使用 Electron `WebContentsView` 承载真实 Chromium 页面，支持多 Tab、临时/持久 Profile、登录态、下载、上传和代理 - Agent 可在独立的 Browser read/interact 授权下执行导航、结构化页面快照、截图、点击、输入、键盘与等待；首次需要时由主窗口弹窗询问，Coding 权限不会隐式开启浏览权限 - Node.js 22.19 或更高版本 - npm（随 Node.js 安装即可） - macOS、Windows 或 Linux ### 本地运行 ```bash git clone https://github.com/DLYZZT/pi-desktop.git cd pi-desktop npm ci npm run dev ``` ### 构建 - macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）：DMG + ZIP - macOS Intel（x64）：DMG + ZIP - Windows（x64）：NSIS 安装程序 - Linux（x64）：AppImage ## 架构设计 Pi Agent Desktop 使用 Electron 三进程模型，将高权限桌面能力、Agent 运行时和 UI 隔离开来。 ```mermaid flowchart LR Main["Electron Main
窗口 · 托盘 · 协议 · Host 监督"] Host["Agent Host / utilityProcess
Pi Agent · 会话 · 文件 · 配置"] UI["Renderer
React 19 · Vite"] Browser["Main-owned WebContentsView
远程网页 · Profile · 网络策略"] Processes["受管项目进程
dev server · watcher · mock API"] Data["~/.pi/agent/
会话 · 模型 · 配置"] Main --> Host Main --> UI Main --> Browser Host -->|"revisioned Browser RPC"| Main Host -->|"POSIX worker / Windows Job helper"| Processes Main -.->|"crash reaper"| Processes Browser -->|"独立授权的 localhost 访问"| Processes UI <-->|"Typed MessagePort IPC"| Host Host <--> Data ``` - **Main**：负责窗口生命周期、菜单、托盘、通知、软件更新、自定义协议和 Agent Host 监督 - **Agent Host**：在独立 `utilityProcess` 中运行 Pi Coding Agent，处理会话、文件、配置与扩展 - **Renderer**：运行 React UI，只通过受控的 preload bridge 与 Host 交互 - **Browser View**：远程站点与 localhost 项目页只进入 Main 创建的沙箱化 `WebContentsView`，不获得应用 preload、Node 或主 Renderer bridge - **无内部本地服务**：应用不使用 TCP 端口承载 UI 或控制面；用户显式启动的受管项目服务可以监听 loopback ## 数据、安全与隐私 - 会话与 Pi 配置默认留在本机 `~/.pi/agent/` - 应用不会为了 UI 通信额外开放本地网络端口 - Renderer 开启 Electron sandbox，并使用严格的 Content Security Policy - preload 只暴露受控桥接接口，Host RPC 由 TypeScript 契约约束 - Agent Browser tools 与高级浏览器模式默认关闭；Main 在任何目标工具副作用前按 session、持久策略、临时 grant、lease 和 policy revision 逐次校验 - 受管后台进程默认关闭，并要求受支持的平台与架构、项目 trust、Session cwd containment、健康的 crash reaper 和有界资源策略；Windows x64 还会校验 Rust helper 的固定路径、版本与完整性。它是生命周期控制，不是容器或沙箱 - 更新客户端只使用正式包内固定的公开 GitHub Release 配置，不接收 Renderer 提供的更新地址或发布凭证 - 微信和 Telegram 只发起出站 long polling，飞书/Lark 使用出站 WebSocket；均不开放 webhook 或本地监听端口 - 模型请求的数据处理方式取决于你配置的模型提供商，请同时查看对应服务的隐私政策 ## 参与开发 ### 常用命令 | 命令 | 说明 | | ---------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | | `npm run dev` | 启动 Vite、主进程构建监听与 Electron | | `npm run typecheck` | 执行 TypeScript 类型检查 | | `npm run test` | 运行自动化测试套件 | | `npm run check:contract` | 检查 API 方法与 Host handler 覆盖关系 | | `npm run smoke` | 运行 Electron 冒烟测试 | | `npm run test:browser-electron` | 运行本地 Browser Electron 集成测试 | | `npm run test:managed-process-workflows` | 运行受管进程生命周期与清理测试 | | `npm run test:windows-managed-helper` | 在 Windows x64 验收 Rust helper 与 Job Object | | `npm run verify` | 执行提交前的完整质量检查 | | `npm run build` | 构建 main、preload 与 renderer | | `npm run pack` | 生成未封装的应用目录 | | `npm run dist` | 生成当前平台配置的全部架构安装包 | | `npm run dist:mac:signed` | 生成当前 Mac 架构的 Developer ID 签名包 | | `npm run dist:mac:notarized` | 生成签名并经 Apple 公证的 macOS 包 | ### 项目结构 ```text src/ ├── contract/ # IPC 类型契约与 RPC 层 ├── main/ # Electron 主进程与 crash reaper ├── preload/ # 安全桥接接口 ├── agent-host/ # Agent、会话、文件、配置与受管进程 ├── renderer/ # React 桌面界面 └── shared/ # 可测试的纯函数与共享模块 native/ └── windows-managed-process-helper/ # Windows x64 Rust / Job Object helper ``` 欢迎通过 [Issues](https://github.com/DLYZZT/pi-desktop/issues) 提交问题或建议，也欢迎直接发起 Pull Request。提交代码前请至少运行： ```bash npm run verify ``` ## 路线图 - statement: Managed components install from the runtime catalog into <userData>/toolchains under a per-component lock, reusing a cached artifact only when its sha256 and byte size match the catalog variant.

The installer probes the staged runtime before atomically activating it via directory rename, writes a per-file sha256 runtime manifest, preserves the previous same-version runtime until the new state is durable, recovers interrupted operations at startup, refuses removal while runtimes are in use, and supports cancellation.

HostManager (src/main/host-manager.ts) supervises the Agent Host: on 'ready' it redelivers toolchain and browser snapshots, pushes managed-process owner identity, starts the 15s ping loop, and kills the child if a pong is absent for 10s.

The Host restart budget allows at most MAX_RESTARTS (2) restarts within a rolling CRASH_WINDOW_MS (30s); exceeding the budget sets the Host status to 'crashed' (reserveHostRestart in src/main/host-restart-core.ts).

BrowserService pushes a BrowserCapabilitySnapshot (revision, browserEnabled, automationEnabled, advancedEnabled, sessionPermissions) through a subscription wired to hostManager.setBrowserCapabilitySnapshot, and the Host applies it via browser:init/browser:changed before syncing session browser tools.

Leases expire after a lease TTL (default 15 min) and are all cleared when the policy revision bumps; a stale lease or revision fails with CAPABILITY_LEASE_EXPIRED or POLICY_REVISION_MISMATCH, forcing the agent to refresh.

Process output is buffered in a bounded ring and read via processes.read/processes.wait returning ManagedProcessLogWindow slices; loopback endpoints are extracted from stdout/stderr and stored (max 8).

The Windows backend (windows-helper-client.ts) uses a native Rust helper (native/windows-managed-process-helper/src/main.rs) that creates a Windows Job object with a completion port to contain the whole process tree, streams length-prefixed frames, and requires parent identity proof (PID, start time, image path).

Toolchain downloads are verified ( SHA-256 hash and bytes) against a signed RuntimeCatalogVariant, and HTTPS redirects are limited to a fixed allow-list of artifact hostnames via assertRuntimeRedirectUrl.
isTrustedDesktopIpcSender (src/main/ipc-trust.ts) requires the IPC sender to be the main BrowserWindow's webContents and its main frame, rejecting nested-frame or other-window senders.
Toolchain execution intent requests are only trusted when they come from the app-owned Host path; a Renderer cannot request a trusted project resolution.

ManagedComponentInstaller (src/main/toolchains/installer.ts) runs a phase machine and verifies every download byte-by-byte against the catalog sha256 before extraction, writes a signed runtime manifest, and resumes partial downloads by re-verifying the existing archive.

.github/workflows/build-desktop.yml runs a test-platforms matrix (Linux x64, macOS arm64/x64, Windows x64), pins Node 22 and (on Windows) a 1.96.1 Rust toolchain, then builds, signs/notarizes macOS, packages the Windows unsigned-Beta installer and Linux AppImage.
sources:
name: Build desktop apps

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    tags:
      - "v*"
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: desktop-build-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ !startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/') }}

jobs:
  test-platforms:
    name: Tests (${{ matrix.name }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: Linux x64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04
            timeout_minutes: 25
          - name: macOS arm64
            runner: macos-15
            timeout_minutes: 25
          - name: macOS x64
            runner: macos-15-intel
            timeout_minutes: 25
          - name: Windows x64
            runner: windows-2025
            timeout_minutes: 45
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: ${{ matrix.timeout_minutes }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Install pinned Rust toolchain (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: rustup toolchain install 1.96.1-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --profile minimal --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc

      - name: Install pinned Windows cross toolchain (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install 1.96.1 --profile minimal --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
          cargo install cargo-xwin --locked --version 0.23.1
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install --no-install-recommends clang-18 lld-18 llvm-18

      - name: Compile-check Windows helper with cargo-xwin (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: npm run build:windows-helper

      - name: Install pinned Rust supply-chain gates (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: |
          cargo install cargo-audit --locked --version 0.22.2
          cargo install cargo-deny --locked --version 0.20.2

      - name: Install Electron binary (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: npx install-electron --no

      - name: Validate Windows managed process helper
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
          $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $true
          python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --no-input Flask==3.1.0 fastapi==0.128.0 uvicorn==0.40.0
          cargo fmt --manifest-path native/windows-managed-process-helper/Cargo.toml --all -- --check
          cargo clippy --manifest-path native/windows-managed-process-helper/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc -- -D warnings
          cargo test --manifest-path native/windows-managed-process-helper/Cargo.toml --locked --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
          cargo audit --file native/windows-managed-process-helper/Cargo.lock --deny warnings
          cargo deny --manifest-path native/windows-managed-process-helper/Cargo.toml --config native/windows-managed-process-helper/deny.toml --locked check
          npm run check:windows-helper-reproducibility
          $env:PI_WINDOWS_HELPER_HANDLE_LOOPS = "100"
          npm run test:windows-managed-helper
          npm run test:managed-process-workflows
          $env:PI_MANAGED_FLOOD_DURATION_MS = "60000"
          $env:PI_MANAGED_FLOOD_PROCESSES = "8"
          $env:PI_MANAGED_FLOOD_STREAMS = "both"
          npm run test:managed-process-flood

      - name: Run unit and handler tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Run cross-platform quality checks (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: |
          npm run format:check
          npm run lint
          npm run typecheck
          npm run check:dependencies
          npm run check:contract
          npm run check:pi-compat
          npm run check:toolchain-contract
          npm run check:toolchain-catalog
          npm run check:browser-i18n

  windows-frameworks:
    name: Windows managed framework acceptance
    runs-on: windows-2025
    timeout-minutes: 35
    env:
      CI: "1"
      NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: "1"
      STORYBOOK_DISABLE_TELEMETRY: "1"
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm

      - name: Set up pinned Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "21"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Install pinned Rust toolchain
        run: rustup toolchain install 1.96.1-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --profile minimal --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc

      - name: Build authoritative Windows helper
        run: npm run check:windows-helper-reproducibility

      - name: Prepare pinned framework fixtures
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $nodeRoot = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP "framework-node-root"
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $nodeRoot -Force | Out-Null
          Push-Location $nodeRoot
          try {
            npm init -y | Out-Null
            npm install --save-exact --no-audit --no-fund next@16.3.2 react@19.2.4 react-dom@19.2.4 storybook@10.5.10 @storybook/react-vite@10.5.10 vite@6.4.3 typescript@5.9.3
          } finally {
            Pop-Location
          }
          $springZip = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP "spring-boot-4.1.1-fixture.zip"
          $springUrl = "https://start.spring.io/starter.zip?type=maven-project&language=java&bootVersion=4.1.1&baseDir=spring-boot-4.1.1-fixture&groupId=com.example&artifactId=fixture&name=SpringFixture&packageName=com.example.fixture&packaging=jar&javaVersion=21&dependencies=web"
          curl.exe --fail --location --retry 3 --output $springZip $springUrl
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Spring Initializr download exited $LASTEXITCODE" }
          Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $springZip -DestinationPath $env:RUNNER_TEMP
          $springRoot = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP "spring-boot-4.1.1-fixture"
          if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $springRoot "mvnw.cmd"))) { throw "Spring wrapper is missing" }
          "PI_FRAMEWORK_NODE_ROOT=$nodeRoot" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV
          "PI_SPRING_BOOT_FIXTURE=$springRoot" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV
          "PI_JAVA_EXECUTABLE=$((Get-Command java).Source)" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV
          "PI_MAVEN_USER_HOME=$(Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'maven-user-home-3.9.16')" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Run real managed framework matrix
        run: npm run test:managed-process-frameworks

  quality:
    name: Quality gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Install pinned Rust toolchain (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: rustup toolchain install 1.96.1-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --profile minimal --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc

      - name: Install Electron binary
        run: npx install-electron --no

      - name: Prepare verified bundled search tools
        run: npm run prepare:bundled-tools -- --target linux-x64

      - name: Configure Electron sandbox
        run: |
          sudo chown root:root node_modules/electron/dist/chrome-sandbox
          sudo chmod 4755 node_modules/electron/dist/chrome-sandbox

      - name: Run full verification
        run: xvfb-run --auto-servernum npm run verify

  package:
    name: ${{ matrix.name }}
    if: github.ref_type != 'tag'
    needs: [quality, test-platforms, windows-frameworks]
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: macOS arm64
            runner: macos-15
            platform: mac
            targets: dmg zip
            arch: arm64
            tool_target: darwin-arm64
            artifact: pi-desktop-macos-arm64
          - name: macOS Intel x64
            runner: macos-15-intel
            platform: mac
            targets: dmg zip
            arch: x64
            tool_target: darwin-x64
            artifact: pi-desktop-macos-x64
          - name: Windows x64
            runner: windows-2025
            platform: win
            targets: nsis
            arch: x64
            tool_target: win32-x64
            artifact: pi-desktop-windows-x64
          - name: Linux x64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04
            platform: linux
            targets: AppImage
            arch: x64
            tool_target: linux-x64
            artifact: pi-desktop-linux-x64
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 35
    env:
      CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY: "false"
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Install Electron runtime for Windows acceptance
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: npx install-electron --no

      - name: Install pinned Rust toolchain (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: rustup toolchain install 1.96.1-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --profile minimal --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc

      - name: Build application
        run: npm run build

      - name: Rebuild authoritative Windows helper for packaging
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: npm run check:windows-helper-reproducibility

      - name: Run Windows managed process integration
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: |
          python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --no-input Flask==3.1.0 fastapi==0.128.0 uvicorn==0.40.0
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
          npm run test:windows-managed-helper
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
          npm run test:managed-process-workflows

      - name: Prepare verified bundled search tools
        run: npm run prepare:bundled-tools -- --target ${{ matrix.tool_target }}

      - name: Run Electron smoke on Windows
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: npm run smoke

      - name: Package ${{ matrix.name }}
        shell: bash
        run: npx electron-builder --${{ matrix.platform }} ${{ matrix.targets }} --${{ matrix.arch }} --publish never

      - name: Generate and verify Windows SBOM
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: |
          npm run build:windows-sbom
          npm run check:windows-sbom

      - name: Configure packaged Electron sandbox (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo chown root:root dist/linux-unpacked/chrome-sandbox
          sudo chmod 4755 dist/linux-unpacked/chrome-sandbox

      - name: Verify packaged toolchains and production startup (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: xvfb-run --auto-servernum npm run check:packaged-toolchains -- ${{ matrix.tool_target }}

      - name: Verify packaged toolchains and production startup (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: npm run check:packaged-toolchains -- ${{ matrix.tool_target }}

      - name: Verify packaged toolchains and production startup (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: npm run check:packaged-toolchains -- ${{ matrix.tool_target }} --release-helper

      - name: Run Windows NSIS upgrade and rollback E2E
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $previous = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP "Pi-Agent-Desktop-Unsigned-Beta-Setup-0.1.10.exe"
          curl.exe --fail --location --retry 3 --output $previous "https://github.com/DLYZZT/pi-desktop/releases/download/v0.1.10/Pi-Agent-Desktop-Unsigned-Beta-Setup-0.1.10.exe"
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "previous installer download exited $LASTEXITCODE" }
          $expected = "5d99744a18f7495c987146a44718dbb5ba7037cf279ada62669aefc9940313c5"
          if ((Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $previous).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ne $expected) { throw "previous installer hash mismatch" }

    if: github.ref_type == 'tag' && startsWith(github.ref_name, 'v')
    needs: [quality, test-platforms, windows-frameworks]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - name: Verify tag and package versions
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          release_commit="$(git rev-parse "${GITHUB_SHA}^{commit}")"
          git fetch --no-tags origin main:refs/remotes/origin/main
          if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$release_commit" origin/main; then
            echo "Release tag must point to a commit contained in main" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          node <<'NODE'
          const packageJson = require("./package.json");
          const packageLock = require("./package-lock.json");

          if (!/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/.test(packageJson.version)) {
            throw new Error(
              `Stable release versions must use x.y.z without a prerelease suffix: ${packageJson.version}`,
            );
          }

          const expectedTag = `v${packageJson.version}`;
          const versions = [
            ["package-lock.json.version", packageLock.version],
            [
              'package-lock.json.packages[""].version',
              packageLock.packages?.[""]?.version,
            ],
          ];

          for (const [source, version] of versions) {
            if (version !== packageJson.version) {
              throw new Error(
                `${source} (${String(version)}) does not match package.json (${packageJson.version})`,
              );
            }
          }

          if (process.env.GITHUB_REF_NAME !== expectedTag) {
            throw new Error(
              `Release tag ${process.env.GITHUB_REF_NAME} must exactly match ${expectedTag}`,
            );
          }

          console.log(`Validated release ${expectedTag}`);
          NODE

      - name: Refuse an existing public release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if is_draft="$(gh release view "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" --json isDraft --jq '.isDraft' 2>/dev/null)"; then
            if [ "$is_draft" != "true" ]; then
              echo "Release $GITHUB_REF_NAME is already public; published assets are immutable" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
          fi

      - name: Verify managed runtime catalog against upstream releases
        env:

      - name: Install dependencies

          CSC_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MAC_CSC_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          APPLE_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_ID }}
          APPLE_APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.APPLE_APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD }}

        run: npm run dist:mac:notarized -- --arm64 --x64

      - name: Verify both signed and notarized apps
        env:
          APPLE_TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_TEAM_ID }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          find_app_for_arch() {
            local expected_arch="$1"
            local app binary
            while IFS= read -r -d '' app; do
              binary="$app/Contents/MacOS/Pi Agent Desktop"
              if [ -f "$binary" ] && lipo -archs "$binary" | grep -qw "$expected_arch"; then
                printf '%s\n' "$app"
                return 0
              fi
            done < <(find dist -maxdepth 3 -type d -name 'Pi Agent Desktop.app' -print0)
            return 1
          }

          verify_app() {
            local app="$1"
            local expected_arch="$2"
            local renderer="$app/Contents/Frameworks/Pi Agent Desktop Helper (Renderer).app"
            local entitlements

            echo "Verifying $expected_arch app: $app"
            codesign --verify --deep --strict --verbose=2 "$app"
            xcrun stapler validate "$app"
            spctl --assess --type execute --verbose=4 "$app"
            codesign -dv --verbose=4 "$app" 2>&1 | grep -Fq "TeamIdentifier=$APPLE_TEAM_ID"

            grep -q 'com.apple.security.cs.allow-jit' <<<"$entitlements"
          }

          x64_app="$(find_app_for_arch x86_64)"

          verify_app "$x64_app" x86_64

      - name: Verify packaged macOS update configuration

          const fs = require("node:fs");
          const path = require("node:path");

          function findUpdateConfigs(directory, matches = []) {
            for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(directory, { withFileTypes: true })) {
              const entryPath = path.join(directory, entry.name);
              if (entry.isDirectory()) {
                findUpdateConfigs(entryPath, matches);
              } else if (
                entry.isFile() &&
                entry.name === "app-update.yml" &&
                entryPath
                  .split(path.sep)
                  .join("/")
                  .endsWith(".app/Contents/Resources/app-update.yml")
              ) {
                matches.push(entryPath);
              }
            }
            return matches;
          }

          function readScalar(document, key) {
            const match = document.match(
              new RegExp(`^\\s*${key}\\s*:\\s*([^#\\r\\n]+)`, "mi"),
            );
            if (!match) {
              throw new Error(`Missing ${key}`);
            }

            const value = match[1].trim();
            if (
              (value.startsWith('"') && value.endsWith('"')) ||
              (value.startsWith("'") && value.endsWith("'"))
            ) {
              return value.slice(1, -1);
            }
            return value;

              provider: "github",
              owner: expectedOwner,
              repo: expectedRepo,
            };

            for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(expected)) {
              const actual = readScalar(document, key);
              if (actual !== value) {
                throw new Error(
                  `${file}: ${key} does not match the expected release repository`,
                );
              }

                "feed override field",
                /^\s*(?:channel|host|protocol|requestHeaders|url)\s*:/im,
              ],
              [
                "credential field",
                /^\s*(?:auth(?:orization)?|headers?|password|passphrase|private[-_]?token|secret|token|(?:api|access)[-_]?key|(?:gh|github)[-_]?token)\s*:/im,
              ],

            for (const [label, pattern] of forbidden) {

              }
            }

            console.log(`Validated ${file}`);
          }

          const configs = findUpdateConfigs("dist").sort();
          if (configs.length !== 2) {

          configs.forEach(verifyUpdateConfig);
          NODE

      - name: Verify macOS release artifacts and metadata
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          version="$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")"

            "dist/Pi-Agent-Desktop-${version}-arm64.dmg" \

          test "$(find "$windows_artifacts" -type f -name '*.exe' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" -eq 1

          if is_draft="$(gh release view "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" --json isDraft --jq '.isDraft' 2>/dev/null)"; then
            if [ "$is_draft" != "true" ]; then
              echo "Release $GITHUB_REF_NAME is already public; published assets are immutable" >&2
              exit 1
            fi

            declare -A expected_assets=()
            for file in "${files[@]}"; do
              expected_assets["${file##*/}"]=1
            done
            while IFS= read -r existing_asset; do
              if [ -n "$existing_asset" ] && [ -z "${expected_assets[$existing_asset]+present}" ]; then
                echo "Removing stale draft asset: $existing_asset"
                gh release delete-asset "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" "$existing_asset" --yes
              fi
            done < <(gh release view "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" --json assets --jq '.assets[].name')

            gh release upload "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" "${files[@]}" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" "${files[@]}" --draft --generate-notes --verify-tag
          fi

#!/usr/bin/env node

import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
import { assertSuccessfulSpawn, resolvePackageFile } from "./process-utils.mjs";

const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");

export function cleanMainBuildOutputs(projectRoot = root) {
  fs.rmSync(path.join(projectRoot, "out", "main"), { recursive: true, force: true });
  fs.rmSync(path.join(projectRoot, "out", "preload"), { recursive: true, force: true });
}

export function buildMain(projectRoot = root) {
  cleanMainBuildOutputs(projectRoot);
  const tsupCli = resolvePackageFile(projectRoot, "tsup", "dist/cli-default.js");
  assertSuccessfulSpawn(
    spawnSync(process.execPath, [tsupCli, "--config", "tsup.config.ts"], {
      cwd: projectRoot,
      stdio: "inherit",
    }),
    "main/preload/host build",
  );
}

const isMain = process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(path.resolve(process.argv[1])).href;
if (isMain) {
  try {
    buildMain();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error);
    process.exitCode = 1;
  }
}

statement: acquireSingleInstanceLock (single-instance.ts) returns false when the lock is already held (now-holding process exits) and focuses/restores the existing window on second-instance.
packaged-cleanup-fault-validation.ts provides a headless mode proving update-install fails closed when managed-process cleanup is uncertain.

Browser authorization, permissions, leases and confirmations are enforced entirely in src/main/browser/ and driven by the renderer via piBridge.browser*; coding permissions never imply browser rights.
npm run dev (scripts/dev.mjs) starts a Vite dev server on localhost:5173, a tsup watch loop building main/preload/host into out/, and launches Electron, tearing down the full process tree on exit.
New worktrees are created under <repoRoot>-worktrees/<sanitized-branch> and added to the allowed file roots; the main worktree cannot be removed and dirty removals are rejected unless forced.
Stale session-history cursors surface as a STALE_CURSOR RPC error rather than silently returning inconsistent history.
A corrupt models.json produces a PARSE_ERROR RPC error rather than silently returning empty config that could be overwritten.
Per-provider refresh failures each yield a PROVIDER_REFRESH_FAILED warning while the last known model snapshot stays available.

The Renderer connects to the Host by asking piBridge.requestHostPort; Main creates a MessageChannelMain, transfers the renderer-side port to the page and the Host-side port to the Host via attach-port.

The Agent Host runs Pi Coding Agent in-process and serves the typed Api/Streams interface over a MessagePort; it owns sessions, models, files, channels, managed processes, and toolchain execution contexts.
Event delivery requires a topic and key match between subscriber and event (either may be '*'); port close rejects all pending calls with CLOSED and clears subscriptions.
AnyMessagePort makes the protocol transport-agnostic across DOM MessagePort, Node worker_threads/utilityProcess, and Electron MessagePortMain, enabling network-free unit tests.

The built-in browser runs tabs as Main-owned WebContentsViews with their own Chromium session/partition; they receive no app preload, no Node, and no Renderer bridge, and Main mediates every operation.

Advanced Browser Mode is a single opt-in toggle with persistence this-launch only, enabling a derived runtime policy that removes site-security headers, disables web security, allows insecure content, and allows certificate-bypass domains.

Desktop IPC handlers in src/main/ipc.ts must be registered through trustedHandle/trustedOn (or the equivalent main.ts guard) so they assert the sender is the main window's main frame via isTrustedDesktopIpcSender.

Adding an Agent Host Api method requires declaring it in Api in src/contract/api.ts and implementing the handler in the server.handle object in src/agent-host/handlers.ts; RpcError codes are shaped automatically by the server.
npm run build builds the Windows managed-process helper (on win32-x64), bundles main/preload/host via scripts/build-main.mjs, and runs vite build for the renderer, producing out/.

The development environment requires Node.js 22.19 or newer but below 23 per package.json engines, and npm run dev builds main/preload/host once, starts tsup watch and Vite, waits for Vite readiness (30s), then launches Electron with VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL.
Managed install/repair/remove/cancel is driven by performAction and gated by user confirmation dialogs in Main.
A candidate probe failure drops that candidate and a whole-scan failure yields a TOOLCHAIN_INTERNAL last-error without crashing; missing required capabilities raise typed ToolchainError codes.
